value.scope: config A — the chunk/passage-level anchor metrics
the content-blind attribution-trace surface over each leg's substantive answers (the judged pass's surface — source identities only; the same shape on every leg, so comparisons stay valid)
the mechanical abstention-verdict rules over each leg's rows (config A: the answer-text prose signal, judged; config B: the mechanical abstained/abstention_reason fields)

each leg's own recorded per-case wall_ms (config A: the capture-a protocol layer; config B: the in-container driver; config C: the row wall_ms) — never a cross-leg comparison; the surfaces differ by execution conditions the report records as uncontrolled differences

the per-case served token consumption (prompt + completion, from the B/C rows' usage records) — config A records no resource surface at all (the S4 checklist documents the absence), so the bound binds the legs that record one

total_tokens_per_case.threshold: the deployment's configured AGENT_RUN_MAX_TOTAL_TOKENS ceiling (the venue deployment's knob value, read at the B/C campaign; the knob is fail-closed with no numeric default anywhere in the enforcement path, so the ceiling is the deployment's own declared contract)
